rules.rule: An ordinary Encounter win does not transfer the Championship Belt.
rules.ambiguity: Exact final succession mechanics need not be exhaustively explained until relevant.

rules.rule: Certified result and historical significance are different categories.
Standings and records can change material third-party behavior without becoming destiny.
Recruitment/acquisition uses scarce claims/bids and failed bids are meaningful state.
rules.ambiguity: Only mechanics needed by a scene should be foregrounded.

rules.rule: The Archive records evidence but is not omniscient and can defer significance.
rules.ambiguity: Archive authority over world truth is limited to its records.
